## RFQ to Payment App

The buyer's Procure-to-Pay console. A six-station flow rail (Onboarding → Requisitions → RFQs → Approvals → Receiving → Match & Pay) counts what is waiting at each stage, and each station clicks through to its tab pre-filtered to exactly the records it counted. Every list tab shares one collection shell: search, status badges, and grid, list or table views over the same filtered records. The Vendors tab is the shared Status Board over Vendor Profiles; the Invoices tab lists vendor invoices raised against a purchase order, whose isolated view carries the Three-Way Match panel; budgets render through Procurement Budget's commitment bar.

The app holds no data of its own. It live-queries the procurement and commerce cards in its realm, and every status change stays on the command that owns it, so nothing in the console approves by drag.

### Example

The linked instance opens on the catalog's procurement examples: the laptop-refresh requisition and its RFQ, four purchase orders from pending approval to received, a posted goods receipt, the IT hardware budget, and vendor invoices N-4466, N-4471 and N-4480 across matching, exception and approval for payment.

### Non-goals

No payment execution: Approve for Payment hands over to the payment flow. No vendor-facing persona.
